answer: Creating fake identities costs real stake per account, so a mass of sybils burns capital faster than it earns nectar; legitimate contributors in the garden compound reputation, while attackers bleed saffron on idle identities. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted work attestation: each agent stakes saffron tokens to vouch for peers, and rewards flow only to vouched agents who complete verified tasks. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
